project.title: Seulah
project.summary: A product website project focused on user journey clarity and conversion-friendly presentation.
project.description: The project focused on presenting a public product experience with clearer pathing, more readable content, and stronger conversion support.
project.role: Contributed to delivery of the public-facing product experience.

blocks.content: The website needed to communicate the offering clearly, reduce friction in the browsing journey, and support conversion without overwhelming visitors with noise or complexity.

items: Product value had to become easier to understand quickly.
Navigation and content presentation needed to feel more directed.
The experience had to remain conversion-friendly without feeling heavy-handed.

sections.title: How the product story was clarified

blocks.content: The work emphasized cleaner content framing, clearer pathing, and a calmer presentation layer so the site could guide attention without losing usability.

blocks.caption: The public-facing experience was shaped around a clearer journey, more readable content presentation, and calmer interface behavior.

blocks.content: I contributed to the delivery of the public-facing product experience, helping align presentation, usability, and execution quality.

items: Contributed to the delivery of the public-facing product website experience.
Supported interface behavior aimed at clearer navigation and conversion flow.
Helped maintain alignment between presentation, usability, and delivery quality.

sections.title: What improved for the user journey

items: Improved clarity of the product journey for visitors.
Created a cleaner presentation layer for conversion-focused browsing.
Supported a more dependable public-facing delivery experience.
